bundle: CanDoItAll Runtime, Tools, and Process Drivers
title: Process-domain driver and special-tool capability adaptation

tasks.title: Model required host capabilities
tasks.description: Let process strategies/special tools declare capabilities such as direct execution, Docker, Python, Node, pwsh script, MCP, desktop, or terminal without branching on OS.

tasks.title: Keep host facts outside process semantics
tasks.description: Host adapters expose availability and execution ports; Processes owns eligibility, alternate strategy, recovery, escalation, evidence, and failure interpretation.

tasks.title: Validate templates/plans before side effects
tasks.description: Compile or launch-check required capabilities and produce deterministic missing-capability diagnostics with safe repair/alternate strategy.

tasks.title: Preserve authority and approvals
tasks.description: Host capability presence never grants workspace/project scope, mutation, tool access, approval, or process authority. Re-run canonical authority and per-run workspace tests.

tasks.title: Adapt special/domain drivers
tasks.description: Review every driver/tool that starts processes, opens files, runs Docker/Python/Node/PowerShell/MCP, or consumes host paths. Route through B01–B05 capabilities.

tasks.title: Normalize receipts/evidence
tasks.description: Serialize logical paths, strategy/driver/capability IDs, tested platform profile, and bounded diagnostics; omit secrets and unnecessary host absolute paths.

tasks.title: Define platform layer semantics
tasks.description: Document that ProcessDriverLayer.Platform means a process strategy package constrained by host capabilities, not a generic operating-system service layer.

tasks.title: Test alternate and unavailable paths
tasks.description: For each special tool, prove success on supported profiles and planned fail/alternate behavior elsewhere without accidental escalation loops.

tasks.title: Issue process architecture gate R3
tasks.description: Independent process/MAF/security review confirms ownership, authority, capability, receipts, and recovery.
